items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 7 June 2026 7:18am
items.description:
##Today##

Cloudy with outbreaks of rain arriving late morning, becoming persistent in the afternoon, heavy at times in the evening. Clearing to become mainly fair overnight.


##Temperature##

##Rainfall (mm):##

8-15, risk of 15-20


##Wind Speed##

23


##Wind Direction##

S


##Wind##

SW 15-20, soon increasing 20-25, occasionally 30 in the afternoon, decreasing W or SW 15-20 early tonight, then veering W or NW 10-15 later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain in the afternoon. Hill fog clearing later.


##Comments##

Strong winds until later. Heavy rain at times later.
